title: On-demand Contents audit for the missing A13 production heat-root owner
question: Does the canonical E:/Dev/Contents corpus contain an owner-approved A13 heat_root_incidence/raw-current map and one-use q-ledger that can fill the first missing R-192 production-cylinder slot without introducing a new model?
method: Search the live Contents Docs/math, Codes, and Runs areas on demand for exact and variant expressions of heat_root_incidence, heat-root incidence, q-ledger, q ledger, raw-current, raw current, production root, and root heat.
Inspect the only candidate Math36 source returned by the broader heat/root search around its revised mixed-BCC verdict and methodology audit.

Compare the source scope against the R-192 same-cylinder owner-slot contract, including the production raw-current spatial map, q-ledger, complete complement, historical-low, forest, returned mean, and one-use sextic allocation.
Keep the Contents corpus reference-only: no external bytes are copied into the canonical claim or production owner without a current owner, hash pin, and revalidation contract.
finding: The scoped live-Contents search returned no source containing the exact A13 production heat-root/raw-current owner or a complete one-use q-ledger. The only broader-search hit was E:/Dev/Contents/Docs/math/TECT-Math36.tex.txt (and its merged duplicate); its revised section describes a mixed-BCC working-branch continuation/validation solver, explicitly withdraws a prior epsilon claim, and warns that seeded or BCC-sensitive runs are not evidence of unbiased spontaneous emergence. It does not provide the R-192 production heat/root map or complete owner-slot ledger. The first R-192 failure therefore persists after on-demand source retrieval; no authorized source can be promoted into A13 from this search.
decision_reason: The audit rules out a simple retrieval omission within the declared live Contents search scope, while preserving the possibility of a separately named owner-approved source outside that scope. The A13 gate cannot advance until the actual production map and q-ledger are supplied and hash-pinned on the existing cylinder.
boundary: T0 reference-only source-acquisition audit. It proves no A13 one-use estimate, OVERLAP_src, Nelson bound, interacting measure, Sector A, Pre-A, QFT, or physical candidate result.
next_action: Keep R-192 stopped at heat_root_incidence. If an owner supplies a production map, pin its exact Contents path and SHA-256, bind it to the side-16 cylinder, rerun the unchanged slot order, and independently verify the q-ledger before any reserve or gate promotion. Do not use the Math36 mixed-BCC continuation solver as a substitute.
no_overclaim: Absence from the declared search scope is not a universal nonexistence theorem. The Math36 document is a scoped mixed-BCC validation source, not an A13 production owner.

qft_interface.closed: The selective Contents retrieval route was exercised without finding a current A13 production owner.
qft_interface.open: The actual heat/root raw-current map, q-ledger, complete owner slots, OVERLAP_src, Nelson, interacting measure, Sector A, Pre-A, and any QFT/continuum bridge.
qft_interface.route: Owner-supplied hash-pinned production map -> R-192 same-cylinder slot audit -> one-use q-ledger and reserve -> A13/OVERLAP_src -> Sector A/Pre-A assessment.

adversarial_review.check: Exact and variant heat/root, q-ledger, raw-current, and production-root terms were searched across the declared live Contents Docs, Codes, and Runs areas.
The no-hit result is scoped to the declared search patterns and paths and is not promoted to a universal nonexistence theorem.
The candidate Math36 mixed-BCC continuation/validation solver is not treated as an unbiased production heat/root map or q-ledger.
No external source is copied or adopted without a current owner, exact hash pin, same-cylinder binding, and independent revalidation.
R-192 remains stopped at its first missing slot; no reserve margin, OVERLAP_src, Nelson, Sector A, or Pre-A conclusion is inferred.
